title: JavaScript deobfuscation
steps: `js-beautify`/prettier first; look for string arrays, decoder functions, and `eval`/`Function` wrappers.
Use `webcrack`/`de4js` or a small Babel AST pass to fold string arrays and constant expressions.
Run suspicious code in a Node VM/browser sandbox with network blocked; log arguments to eval/Function.
Check source maps, `atob`/`crypto` calls, and DOM sinks; extract the check/flag path and confirm in the browser.
falsifier: The code is server-side or WASM; static JS deobfuscation cannot recover it.
